\documentclass[twocolumn]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\title{Quantum Electrodynamics of Bound States in Strong Coulomb Fields}
\author{J. R. Oppenheimer \and H. A. Bethe}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
We calculate radiative corrections to electron binding energies in high-Z hydrogenic ions.
\end{abstract}
\section{Introduction and Field Equations}
The Dirac Hamiltonian in an external potential is:
\begin{equation}
H_D = \boldsymbol{\alpha}\cdot(\mathbf{p} - e\mathbf{A}) + \beta m + e A_0
\end{equation}
\section{Vacuum Polarization}
The conserved polarization tensor satisfies:
\begin{equation}
q_\mu \Pi^{\mu\nu}(q) = 0
\end{equation}
